name: pfpstore
description: Precise shared-x87 destination-store regression. A present/read-only PTE covers FISTP m32 at linear 0x401000. The #PF handler records error code P|W=3, makes the PTE writable, flushes CR3 and IRETs. Correct behavior leaves ST0 live until restart and stores 3; an adapter that probes with a read consumes ST0 before the write #PF, so the restart observes an empty stack and fails the ESI=3 witness.
